g.text: Networks: mean +/- sample SD across 3 training seeds (ddof=1). SVM: one model, no training error bars.
At each SNR, average 5 noise repeats within each model first; noise-repeat SD is within-model variation.
Training SD and noise-repeat SD describe this fixed split; neither is a population confidence interval.
